visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black top and small gold bow-shaped earrings, faces the camera directly in a brightly lit indoor environment. Behind her, a warm-toned floor lamp and a large green potted plant (Monstera) are visible against a white-tiled or brick wall. (2) The camera shifts to a handheld perspective, focusing on an iPhone held by a hand with white-tipped manicured nails. The screen displays the LINE messaging app interface with multiple chat entries. (3) The user demonstrates an interface trick by swiping down from the top edge to reveal system icons and then long-pressing a specific chat message, causing a preview window to pop up without entering the chat fully. (4) The woman reappears in a medium close-up, holding the phone and smiling broadly as she continues speaking. She gestures with her hands while the background remains the consistent warm, studio-like domestic setting.
